The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of oscillatory features in a model of the primordial power spectra can improve significantly the fit of CMB data, and the inclusion of LRG-7 and SN data do not degrade significantly the fit of the features model, while allowing to better constrain the oscillation's amplitude.

the presence of oscillatory features in models with interrupted slow-roll can significantly improve the agreement with data, and the best fit model is consistent with the presence of a step in the primodial spectrum at the scale k ~ 10^-2 Mpc^-1.

the current data do not allow to exclude models with features in the spectrum of perturbations, and that future experiments like the Planck satellite and the Euclid space mission might be able to distinguish between featureless and feature models.
